text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I have triumphed. Just as I expected.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. As I said, I paced myself<n>for a
2,000-meter race.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If today's performance is any<n>indication, our next
race should pose<n>little challenge.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
At long last, we can begin conquering<n>the Classic
Triple Crown with our first<n>objective...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: The Satsuki Sho awaits us.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Just as we solidify our resolve to<n>enter the Satsuki
Sho...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Knock, knock.

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager
text_block_list.text: President, um...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's you again. What did you think<n>of my
performance?

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager
text_block_list.text:
You were amazing... and so confident!<n>You're way
above the rest of us...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hm? Now, don't—

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager
text_block_list.text: Sorry! I-I didn't mean... That is... I<n>should be going!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Dash...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Don't worry about it. I'll speak with<n>her later.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Right now, we should review today's<n>performance.
Time is money, as they<n>say, and it would not do to
waste it.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf and I put our heads<n>together for a
while and review her<n>race.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Just as we arrive back at the<n>academy...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: VROOOOOM! Screeeeech!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hm? An engine this loud could only<n>mean...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Heya, Rudolf!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky. Just as I thought.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
A little birdie told me you're finally<n>going for the
Classic Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: That's one gnarly goal! I hope you<n>pull it off! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's Maruzensky the Beast, the<n>so-called "Hot Rod"
who has taken<n>the world by storm, and made her
debut even earlier than Symboli<n>Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With the Emperor on one side and the<n>Beast on the
other, it's hard to hide<n>my excitement as a trainer.
And yet...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Gnarly... hmmm. Perhaps... no, that's<n>not funny
enough.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You're not trying to turn that into a<n>pun, are you?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You could pull a muscle doing that.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I thought it might be a worthy<n>challenge... as well as
a potent<n>addition to my arsenal if I could pull it<n>off.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, not cool! You can't just take the<n>things I say
and turn them into gags!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haha... My apologies.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The two seem like they're on good<n>terms. I can't
help but notice that<n>Symboli Rudolf looks a little
more<n>relaxed in Maruzensky's company.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, shoot! Gotta dash! I'm keeping<n>the teacher
waiting!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I think the school found out about me<n>using an
employee parking spot.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it's not like anyone else was<n>using it!
What's the problem, right?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Are you certain you want to ask the<n>president of
the student council? You<n>might not like the answer.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Aw, man... Why do you have to be<n>such a square?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Guess I'd better be going. Hasta la<n>vista, baby!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haha... As energetic as ever.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I see her as less of a friend and more<n>as... an
object of interest, one might<n>say.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As you are surely aware, her<n>effortless strength is
causing quite<n>the stir in the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I regard her as a worthy contributor to<n>the future I
mean to build.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And besides, I find her... intriguing.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: She stirs my most basic racing<n>instincts.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I think of myself as drawing strength<n>from many
things. My dreams, my<n>ideals, the expectations of
the<n>students I lead.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But I cannot help but wonder... if I<n>were to meet her
on the track, fueled<n>only by my thirst for victory,
who<n>would prevail?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Which of us would truly prove the<n>strongest?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
For just an instant, something shines<n>in her eyes,
but it quickly fades.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But I have a long way to go before<n>I'm qualified to
speak of such things.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I ought to get back to work.<n>I'm going to
return to the academy.<n>How about you?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But of course. There is always more<n>to be done. If
that is all, then I will take<n>my leave.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
If she were to race against<n>Maruzensky as she is
now—a racer<n>pursuing an ideal—she would
undoubtedly compete as the<n>"Emperor."

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But after today, a part of me hopes<n>that someday
she has the chance to<n>compete simply as Symboli
Rudolf<n>instead.
